title: Requirement Analysis
description: Analyze the raw requirement, classify EXPLICIT/INFERRED/ASSUMED/UNKNOWN information, detect ambiguity, and produce a normalized requirement with testable acceptance criteria.

title: Architecture Design
description: Design the component architecture, request/data flow, persistence design, and production evolution path for the URL shortener prototype.

title: API Contract
description: Author artifacts/openapi.yaml describing POST /urls, GET /{short_code}, GET /urls/{short_code}/analytics exactly as designed in architecture.md.
validation_criteria: every route in architecture.md's API Boundaries table is present
request/response schemas match models to be implemented in TASK-005/006/007

title: Database Schema
description: Author artifacts/schema.sql defining the urls and redirect_events tables with the indexes justified in architecture.md.
validation_criteria: urls table supports short_code, original_url, created_at, expires_at, redirect_count, last_accessed_at

title: URL Creation Service
description: Implement models/repositories/services for idempotent short-URL creation (AC-001, AC-002, AC-003) plus the POST /urls API route.

title: Redirect Service
description: Implement redirect resolution (AC-004, AC-005, AC-006) including expiration checks, plus the GET /{short_code} API route.

title: Analytics Component
description: Implement redirect-event recording and aggregate analytics retrieval (AC-007, AC-008) plus GET /urls/{short_code}/analytics API route.

title: Unit Tests
description: Write unit tests for url_service, url_repository, analytics_service covering happy paths, invalid input, boundary conditions.
validation_criteria: tests actually execute via python -m pytest
AC-001..AC-003, AC-006..AC-008 covered at unit level

title: Integration / API Tests
description: Write API-level tests using FastAPI TestClient covering full request/response cycles, persistence across calls, and failure paths.
validation_criteria: tests actually execute via python -m pytest

title: Documentation
description: Produce API documentation and setup/testing instructions consistent with the actual implementation.
validation_criteria: documentation matches actual implemented behavior, no fabricated endpoints

title: Independent Validation
description: Independently review requirement coverage, architecture consistency, API/schema consistency, test results, security and scalability risk, and documentation accuracy.
validation_criteria: final status is one of PASS / PASS_WITH_WARNINGS / FAIL / NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW, backed by evidence
